en: Black‑and‑white image showing six men posed indoors in front of a display of military drums, banners, and standards. The men wear ornate 19th‑century military band or drum-major uniforms with tall bearskin or shako-style headgear; some also wear long white aprons and large false beards as part of ceremonial dress. Several drums are on the floor at their feet. Above and behind them hang regimental flags, crests, and a large crescent-shaped drum banner. A line of text is printed along the upper margin of the image.
